question: Where’s the nearest zoo that lies north of MSU Poultry Research & Teaching Center, Lansing, MI?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'zoo' AND ( degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MSU Poultry Research & Teaching Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lansing%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360 OR degrees(ST_Azimuth( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MSU Poultry Research & Teaching Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lansing%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 0 AND 22.5 ) ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%MSU Poultry Research & Teaching Center%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Lansing%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%MI%' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1;
